subject.title: feat(macos): adopt the shared read-only chat transcript cache

question: Should macOS persist gateway-scoped recent chat transcript text without auth-principal scoping once the cache-rebinding bug is fixed?
rationale: The patch creates a new local transcript store and deliberately excludes credentials from the cache identity, which is a security/privacy boundary choice beyond a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Accept gateway-scoped text cache
options.body: Merge after the rebinding fix and live macOS offline proof, keeping the bounded text-only cache scoped by gateway identity.

options.title: Require stronger partitioning
options.body: Ask for principal scoping, opt-in behavior, or a clear purge surface before merging the macOS persisted cache.

options.title: Pause macOS adoption
options.body: Hold this PR until the shared iOS cache base and security review settle the permanent cache contract.

recommendation.title: Accept gateway-scoped text cache
recommendation.body: Merge after the rebinding fix and live macOS offline proof, keeping the bounded text-only cache scoped by gateway identity.

likelyOwner.reason: The same account owns the current PR and has recent macOS chat and remote gateway history for this surface.
